clips.title: The story
paras: Hunters and travelers come to Farstrider Lodge in southeastern Loch Modan for training, supplies, and work in the wilds. Its high elven style sets it apart, though dwarves and humans live there too.

Farstrider Lodge has an unusual look among the stone buildings of Khaz Modan. Its design suggests high elven craft. Vyrin Swiftwind is the only known high elf who still lives there, among dwarves and humans. No one knows who founded the lodge or when it was built.

In the southeastern hills of Loch Modan, Farstrider Lodge offers a stopping place for hunters and travelers bound for the surrounding wilds. Hunter and pet trainers work there, alongside merchants and people seeking help with local wildlife.
